purpose: Illustrative product photos for fictional JinglePro demo campaigns; real merchant campaigns use the uploaded photo.

assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a photorealistic product photograph for a fictional Brazilian neighborhood pizzeria's vertical social media ad. Two freshly baked large pizzas on a dark rustic wooden counter, one mozzarella with basil and one Brazilian calabresa sausage and onion. Delicious realistic melted cheese, golden blistered crust, warm side light, shallow depth of field, premium authentic food photography, three-quarter overhead angle. Vertical 9:16 composition, pizzas occupy central 65% with breathing room at top and bottom for later text overlays. No people, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Output intended as product photo in a moving promotional video.
